definitions.gloss: custom-made clothing, made-to-order clothing, bespoke clothing
definitions.explanation: Clothing that is made to an individual customer's measurements and specifications, as opposed to ready-made or off-the-rack clothing.

examples.japanese: {注文服|ちゅうもんふく}は{体|からだ}にぴったり{合|あ}う。
examples.english: Custom-made clothing fits the body perfectly.

examples.japanese: {結婚式|けっこんしき}のために{注文服|ちゅうもんふく}のスーツを{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I had a custom suit made for the wedding.

examples.japanese: {注文服|ちゅうもんふく}は{既製服|きせいふく}より{高|たか}いが、{着心地|きごこち}が{全然|ぜんぜん}{違|ちが}う。
examples.english: Custom-made clothing is more expensive than ready-made, but the comfort is completely different.

notes:
A compound of {注文|ちゅうもん} (order, custom order) + {服|ふく} (clothing). Also called オーダーメイド (order-made) in Japanese, which is a wasei-eigo term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {注文服|ちゅうもんふく}を{作|つく}る: to have custom clothing made
- {注文服|ちゅうもんふく}の{仕立|した}て: tailoring of custom clothing
- {注文服|ちゅうもんふく}の{店|みせ}: custom clothing shop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {既製服|きせいふく}: ready-made clothing, off-the-rack — the opposite; mass-produced in standard sizes
- オーダーメイド: custom-made — wasei-eigo loanword, more commonly used in casual conversation
- {仕立|した}て{服|ふく}: tailored clothing — emphasizes the tailoring process
